rows.title_ne: ३० वर्षपछि पहिलो संसदीय निर्वाचन

rows.summary_ne: सन् १९९१ मे १२ (वि.सं. २०४८ वैशाख २९) मा नेपालमा ३० वर्षपछि पहिलो संसदीय निर्वाचन भयो; नेकपा (एमाले) ले २०५ मध्ये ६९ सिट जितेर दोस्रो ठूलो दल बन्यो र मनमोहन अधिकारी प्रमुख प्रतिपक्षी नेता बने।
rows.summary_en: On 12 May 1991, Nepal held its first parliamentary election in 30 years; the CPN (UML) won 69 of 205 seats to become the second-largest party, and Man Mohan Adhikari became leader of the opposition.

raw_compact.sen: On 12 May 1991, Nepal held its first parliamentary election in 30 years; the CPN (UML) won 69 of 205 seats to become the second-largest party, and Man Mohan Adhikari became leader of the opposition.

raw_compact.ten: First parliamentary election in 30 years
raw_compact.tne: ३० वर्षपछि पहिलो संसदीय निर्वाचन

rows.title_ne: नेकपा (एकता केन्द्र) को पहिलो महाधिवेशन
rows.title_en: CPN (Unity Centre) holds its first convention
rows.summary_ne: सन् १९९१ नोभेम्बर २५ (वि.सं. २०४८ मंसिर ९) मा नेकपा (माओवादी) को पूर्ववर्ती नेकपा (एकता केन्द्र) ले पहिलो महाधिवेशन गरी "दीर्घकालीन सशस्त्र सङ्घर्ष" को लाइन अपनायो।
rows.summary_en: On 25 November 1991, the CPN (Unity Centre), predecessor of the CPN (Maoist), held its first convention and adopted the line of "protracted armed struggle".

raw_compact.sen: On 25 November 1991, the CPN (Unity Centre), predecessor of the CPN (Maoist), held its first convention and adopted the line of "protracted armed struggle".

rows.title_ne: नेकपा (एमाले) द्वारा "जनताको बहुदलीय जनवाद" अङ्गीकार
rows.title_en: CPN (UML) adopts "People's Multiparty Democracy"
rows.summary_ne: सन् १९९३ जनवरीमा काठमाडौंमा भएको नेकपा (एमाले) को पाँचौँ महाधिवेशनले जनताको बहुदलीय जनवादलाई पार्टीको कार्यदिशा बनायो; मनमोहन अधिकारी अध्यक्ष र मदन भण्डारी महासचिव चुनिए।
rows.summary_en: In January 1993, the fifth congress of the CPN (UML) in Kathmandu officially adopted People's Multiparty Democracy as the party line, electing Man Mohan Adhikari chairman and Madan Bhandari general secretary.

raw_compact.sen: In January 1993, the fifth congress of the CPN (UML) in Kathmandu officially adopted People's Multiparty Democracy as the party line, electing Man Mohan Adhikari chairman and Madan Bhandari general secretary.

rows.title_en: Madhav Kumar Nepal becomes CPN (UML) general secretary
rows.summary_ne: सन् १९९३ मेमा मदन भण्डारीको निधनपछि माधवकुमार नेपाल नेकपा (एमाले) का महासचिव चुनिए।
rows.summary_en: In May 1993, after Madan Bhandari's death, Madhav Kumar Nepal was elected general secretary of the CPN (UML).

rows.title_en: CPN (Unity Centre) splits; Prachanda's faction later becomes CPN (Maoist)
rows.summary_ne: सन् १९९४ मे २२ (वि.सं. २०५१ जेठ ८) मा नेकपा (एकता केन्द्र) र संयुक्त जनमोर्चा दुई भागमा विभाजित भए; पुष्पकमल दाहाल (प्रचण्ड) नेतृत्वको उग्र पक्षले पछि आफ्नो नाम नेकपा (माओवादी) राख्यो।
rows.summary_en: On 22 May 1994, the CPN (Unity Centre) and its United People's Front split in two; the militant faction led by Pushpa Kamal Dahal (Prachanda) later renamed itself the Communist Party of Nepal (Maoist).

rows.title_ne: "आफ्नो गाउँ आफैँ बनाऔँ" कार्यक्रम र वृद्धभत्ता सुरु

rows.title_en: Supreme Court blocks the dissolution sought by Prime Minister Adhikari; his minority government falls
rows.summary_ne: सन् १९९५ सेप्टेम्बर १० (वि.सं. २०५२ भदौ २५) मा विपक्षी दलहरूले चुनौती दिएपछि सर्वोच्च अदालतले प्रधानमन्त्री मनमोहन अधिकारीको प्रतिनिधि सभा विघटनको सिफारिस खारेज गर्‍यो र उनको अल्पमत सरकार ढल्यो।
rows.summary_en: On 10 September 1995, the Supreme Court dismissed Prime Minister Man Mohan Adhikari's recommendation to dissolve the House of Representatives after it was challenged by opposition parties, and his minority government fell.
